newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

* Indonesian monetary authorities were expected on Tuesday to announce new measures to further tighten rupiah liquidity, Coordinating Minister for Finance and Economics Saleh Afiff said on Monday following a meeting among monetary authorities including himself, Finance Minister Mar''ie Muhammad, central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono, state secretary Murdiono and two senior economic advisers.

* Indonesian State Planning Minister Ginanjar Kartasasmita said on Monday the government will make efforts to maintain 1997 inflation below 10 percent despite the weakness of the rupiah against the dollar.

* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 108.70 points, or 1.4 percent, to 7,803.36, regaining almost half of Friday's 247-point decline, which was the biggest percentage drop in nearly six years.
* On Monday, the composite index closed 2.93 percent, or 18.07 points, down at 599.64 points after plunging to an intra-day low of 565.78 points in the morning.
* The Indonesian rupiah was quoted at 2,970.00/80.00 against the dollar at 0140 GMT compared with 2,960.00/80.00 at the opening.
* Banks and finance sectors as they are likely to be the hardest hit by the ongoing currency turmoil.
* State-controlled blue chips Telkom, Timah and BNI on market talk the government may intervene to further support prices of the stocks.
* Textile firm Indo-Rama following announcement of a sharp rise in first-half net profit.
